general_information.Description: This course teach Data Mining in the fashion of project/problem-based learning. At the beginning of the course, students choose projects, among given a list. Then, during the project/problem solving process, students will decide to choose some theoretical topics that teachers can guide them to present in the class, where teacher may correct their understanding on the theoretical aspect. In between theoretical sessions, there are practical session where teacher help students in their problems/projects. The course ends with the submission of students project work/problem solution. Continuous assessment done through evaluation of student presentations and student project work/problem solution. Assessment scheme: Progress assessment: 1) 01 Presentation: 20% 2) 01 Project: 40% FE: Final Exam: 40% Completion Criteria: - Every component of progress assessment must be > 0. - Final Result >=5 & Final Exam Score >=4
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information.
general_information.Tools: Python, Java, C, C++, Excel, R

schedule.Topic: Introduction to course. Outline of a Data Mining project (business goal (Chapter 2 & 3 Textbook 2), team setup with business minded person + data science person + optional engineers), data source preparation, data pre-processing, choose 2 models/ways to process data (Chapter 4 Textbook 2), do the processing (Chapter 4 Textbook 2), compare result & interpret the result (Chapter 5 Textbook 2), answer business question). Introduction to project. Assigning projects to students.
